reason: A read-only diagnostic plugin that scans DSH multi-frame zstd session files for corruption, truncation, empty sessions, and stray files, then reports findings and suggestions.

summaries.zh: 只读扫描 DSH 多帧 zstd 会话文件，诊断损坏、截断、空会话和残留文件并生成健康报告。
summaries.en: A read-only tool that scans DSH multi-frame zstd session files for corruption, truncation, empty sessions, and stray files, then generates health reports.

capabilities: Read-only scanning of DSH session files under the configured sessions directory
Optional deep decoding for event statistics and interruption detection
Generation of health reports and cleanup or repair suggestions without automatic changes
